Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding membership on the board of natural resources.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to modernizing the criteria for membership on theboard of natural resources without altering the number of members; andamending RCW 43.30.205.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.30.205 and 2003 c 334 s 104 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The board shall consist of six members: (a) The governor or the governor's designee((,)); (b) The superintendent of public instruction((,)); (c) The commissioner ((of public lands, the dean of the college)); (d) The director of the University of Washington school of forestresources ((of the University of Washington,)); (e) The dean of the Washington State University college ofagriculture ((of Washington State University)), human, and naturalresource sciences; and (f) A representative of those counties that contain state forestlands acquired or transferred under RCW 79.22.010, 79.22.040, and79.22.020. p. 1 HB 2503 (2)(a) The county representative on the board shall be selected bythe legislative authorities of those counties that contain state forestlands acquired or transferred under RCW 79.22.010, 79.22.040, and79.22.020. The eligible counties shall utilize a private statewideassociation representing the interests of the legislative authoritiesand executives of Washington counties to coordinate selection of thecounty representative. In the selection of the county representative,each participating county shall have one vote. ((The Washington stateassociation of counties shall conduct a meeting for the purpose ofmaking the selection and shall notify the board of the selection.)) (b) The county representative ((shall)) must be a duly electedmember of a county legislative authority who shall serve a term of fouryears unless the representative should leave office for any reason.The initial term shall begin on July 1, 1986.
